description: H4 — 'Proč náklady účtu 501001 v roce 2025 vyskočily?' The question resolves EXACTLY as H1 does: same entities, same members, gap-free. The open Golem still refuses, with the lattice attached — 'I understood you completely; I cannot investigate causes.' The predicate is the lattice's own: the question names NO operator this Golem holds a body for, and skill entries are how an estate declares which actions its Golem can perform (RV-35). No intent classification is involved, and the OS Golem has none to involve.
invariants: a refusal is not an error — the lattice rides along and PROVES the understanding
the refusal names what it can still do (the composable residue), not an apology
no code path invents intent: the paygrade decision is made of what the lattice can say
